public_gates: M183 M168 and M170 replay retention
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run PPO in M271
do not run multiple actor-update seeds before the first seed passes
do not promote based only on combined objective improvement
do not delete or loosen the old protected key diagnostic
hypothesis: A small actor-coupling update from M264 using the M270 source-balanced multi-surface corpus can improve the combined objective while retaining old M183/M193 and current M267 proof surfaces.
success_criteria: run exactly one small actor update before any repeat or PPO
improve fixed M270 objective versus M264 on independent fixed-batch eval
preserve all listed public replay gates
failure_criteria: run PPO before the actor update is gated
drop any old or refreshed replay row
lose behavior retention or protected-key diagnostic
combined objective improves but proof surfaces regress

commands.name: m271_actor_update
commands.command: Run one small actor-coupling update from m264_a001 using the M270 source-balanced combined corpus, then gate fixed objective, replay surfaces, protected key, and behavior.

decision_rule: M271 may admit repeat evidence only if one multi-surface actor update improves the fixed combined objective and preserves old plus refreshed proof surfaces, behavior, and the protected-key diagnostic. PPO remains blocked.
